statement: The recursive Bayes filter computes the posterior state distribution p(x_k | z_{1:k}) recursively in two steps: a prediction step p(x_k | z_{1:k-1}) = \int p(x_k | x_{k-1}) p(x_{k-1} | z_{1:k-1}) d x_{k-1} and an update step p(x_k | z_{1:k}) = \frac{p(z_k | x_k) p(x_k | z_{1:k-1})}{p(z_k | z_{1:k-1})}.

symbols.meaning: True state vector at time step k
Measurement vector at time step k
Sequence of measurements from time step 1 to k
Predicted state distribution (prior belief at step k)
Updated state distribution (posterior belief at step k)

steps.text: Assume the true state x_k follows a first-order Markov process, making current state x_k conditionally independent of earlier states given the immediately preceding state x_{k-1}: p(x_k | x_{k-1}, x_{k-2}, \dots, x_0) = p(x_k | x_{k-1}).
Assume the measurement z_k depends only on the current state x_k and is conditionally independent of all other states: p(z_k | x_k, x_{k-1}, \dots, x_0) = p(z_k | x_k).
Express the joint probability distribution over all states and measurements up to time k: p(x_0, \dots, x_k, z_1, \dots, z_k) = p(x_0) \prod_{i=1}^{k} p(z_i | x_i) p(x_i | x_{i-1}).

Formulate the predict step by marginalizing out the previous state x_{k-1} to obtain the predicted state probability distribution: p(x_k | z_{1:k-1}) = \int p(x_k | x_{k-1}) p(x_{k-1} | z_{1:k-1}) d x_{k-1}.

Formulate the update step using Bayes' rule to combine the measurement likelihood and the predicted state distribution: p(x_k | z_{1:k}) = \frac{p(z_k | x_k) p(x_k | z_{1:k-1})}{p(z_k | z_{1:k-1})} \propto p(z_k | x_k) p(x_k | z_{1:k-1}).
Compute the normalization factor in the denominator by marginalizing over all possible current states x_k: p(z_k | z_{1:k-1}) = \int p(z_k | x_k) p(x_k | z_{1:k-1}) d x_k.

assumptions.assumption: The true state sequence follows a first-order unobserved Markov process.
assumptions.breaks_when: The state transition at step k depends directly on states earlier than step k-1.

assumptions.assumption: Measurements at step k are conditionally independent of past states given the current state x_k.
assumptions.breaks_when: Measurements have memory or correlated noise across time independent of the state x_k.

failure_modes.signature: Posterior distribution functional form grows increasingly complex over time, preventing closed-form integration.
failure_modes.cause: Non-linear transition or measurement models, or non-Gaussian probability density functions.
